summary: Replace interface{} with any.
bad: var value interface{}

summary: Replace basic types in sync/atomic calls with atomic types.
bad:
var count int32
atomic.AddInt32(&count, 1)

summary: Remove redundant re-declaration of loop variables.
Replace explicit loops over maps with calls to maps package.
bad: for key, value := range source { destination[key] = value }

summary: Replace if/else statements with calls to min or max.
bad: if first < second { result = first } else { result = second }

summary: Use new(value) in Go 1.26 or later to allocate an initialized value.
bad:
func pointer(value int) *int { return &value }
func process() { use(pointer(42)) }

summary: Use omitzero when a zero-valued struct field should not appear in JSON.
bad: type Event struct { Time time.Time `json:"time,omitempty"` }

summary: Remove obsolete //+build comments.
Replace 3-clause for loops with for-range over integers.
bad: for index := 0; index < count; index++ { use(index) }

summary: Replace reflect.TypeOf(x) with TypeFor[T]().
bad: reflect.TypeOf((*io.Reader)(nil)).Elem()

summary: Replace backward loops over slices with slices.Backward.
bad: for index := len(values) - 1; index >= 0; index-- { use(values[index]) }

summary: Replace loops with slices.Contains or slices.ContainsFunc.
Replace sort.Slice with slices.Sort for basic types.
bad: sort.Slice(values, func(i, j int) bool { return values[i] < values[j] })

summary: Use iterators instead of Len/At-style APIs.
bad: for index := 0; index < tuple.Len(); index++ { use(tuple.At(index)) }

summary: Replace HasPrefix/TrimPrefix with CutPrefix.
Replace ranging over Split/Fields with SplitSeq/FieldsSeq.
bad: for _, part := range strings.Split(input, ",") { use(part) }

summary: Replace += with strings.Builder.
Replace context.WithCancel with t.Context in tests.
bad:
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
defer cancel()
use(ctx)

summary: Replace unsafe pointer arithmetic with function calls.
bad: unsafe.Pointer(uintptr(pointer) + uintptr(offset))

summary: Replace wg.Add(1)/go/wg.Done() with wg.Go.
